en: Genesis 2

p.src: 1  The heavens, the earth, and all their vast array were finished.

en: The heavens, the earth, and all their vast array were finished.
u.src: 1  The heavens, the earth, and all their vast array were finished.

p.src: 2  On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done.

ja: に、ご自分がなさっていた仕事を完成された。そして、ご自分がなさっていたすべての仕事を終えて、第七日に
en: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done.
u.src: 2  On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done.

p.src: 3  God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.

ja: のすべてのわざを終え、この日に
en: God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.
u.src: 3  God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.

p.src: 4  This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens.

ja: されたときの記録である。
en: This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens.
u.src: 4  This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens.

ja:
2:4 「記録」と訳されているヘブライ語「תּוֹלְדוֹת」（トレドット）は、「系譜」「由来」「歴史」を意味する。
2:4 ここで「主」と訳されているヘブライ語は、神の固有名「יהוה」（ヤハウェ）である。
en: 2:4 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

p.src: 5  No plant of the field was yet on the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for the LORD God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There was not a man to till the ground,

ja: 地にはまだ野の低木がなく、
もまだ生えていなかった。
もいなかったからである。
en: No plant of the field was yet on the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for the LORD God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There was not a man to till the ground,
u.src: 5  No plant of the field was yet on the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for the LORD God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There was not a man to till the ground,

p.src: 6  but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.

en: but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.
u.src: 6  but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.

p.src: 7  The LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

en: The LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
u.src: 7  The LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

p.src: 8  The LORD God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.

en: The LORD God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.
u.src: 8  The LORD God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.

p.src: 9  Out of the ground the LORD God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food, including the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

ja: 物として良いすべての
の知識の木を生えさせた。
en: Out of the ground the LORD God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food, including the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
u.src: 9  Out of the ground the LORD God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food, including the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

p.src: 10  A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became the source of four rivers.

ja: が、園を潤すためにエデンから
ていた。それはそこから
en: A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became the source of four rivers.
u.src: 10  A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became the source of four rivers.

p.src: 11  The name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

ja: はピションである。それは
en: The name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
u.src: 11  The name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

p.src: 12  and the gold of that land is good. Bdellium and onyx stone are also there.

ja: い。そこにはブデリウムとシマメノウもある。
en: and the gold of that land is good. Bdellium and onyx stone are also there.
u.src: 12  and the gold of that land is good. Bdellium and onyx stone are also there.

en: 2:12 or, aromatic resin

p.src: 13  The name of the second river is Gihon. It is the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush.

ja: はギホンである。それはクシュの
en: The name of the second river is Gihon. It is the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush.
u.src: 13  The name of the second river is Gihon. It is the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush.

p.src: 14  The name of the third river is Hiddekel. This is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.

ja: はヒデケルである。これはアッシリアの前を
はユーフラテスである。
en: The name of the third river is Hiddekel. This is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.
u.src: 14  The name of the third river is Hiddekel. This is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.

p.src: 15  The LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.

en: The LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.
u.src: 15  The LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.

p.src: 16  The LORD God commanded the man, saying, “You may freely eat of every tree of the garden;

ja: からでも、思いのままに
en: The LORD God commanded the man, saying, “You may freely eat of every tree of the garden;
u.src: 16  The LORD God commanded the man, saying, “You may freely eat of every tree of the garden;

p.src: 17  but you shall not eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”

ja: べてはならない。それを
en: but you shall not eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”
u.src: 17  but you shall not eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”

p.src: 18  The LORD God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”

ja: が一人でいるのは良くない。わたしは彼のために、
en: The LORD God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”
u.src: 18  The LORD God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”

ja: 2:18 または「彼に適した」「彼に対応する」。
en: 2:18 or, suitable for, or appropriate for.

p.src: 19  Out of the ground the LORD God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called every living creature became its name.

ja: るために、人のところに連れて来られた。
en: Out of the ground the LORD God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called every living creature became its name.
u.src: 19  Out of the ground the LORD God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called every living creature became its name.

p.src: 20  The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper comparable to him.

en: The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper comparable to him.
u.src: 20  The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper comparable to him.

p.src: 21  The LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep. As the man slept, he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.

en: The LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep. As the man slept, he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.
u.src: 21  The LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep. As the man slept, he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.

p.src: 22  The LORD God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.

en: The LORD God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.
u.src: 22  The LORD God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.

p.src: 23  The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”

en: The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”
u.src: 23  The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”

p.src: 24  Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.

en: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.
u.src: 24  Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.

p.src: 25  The man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.

en: The man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.
u.src: 25  The man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.
